summary: Defines the list of pop-up types the desk can show and the shape of the state that says which one is open. Only the type definition was visible; the dialogs themselves were not in the packet.
purpose: Keeps one shared rule for which desk pop-up is open and what extra details it needs.
why: Likely reason: one central list keeps the desk's pop-ups consistent.
how: The file imports the store, auth store, task type and a display name helper. It exports a state type with a kind (one of twelve values, including none) and an optional payload. The rest of the component, which draws the pop-ups, was not in the packet.
inputs: Store and auth data (only the imports are visible), and a dialog state object chosen by the caller.
risks: The payload is typed as any, so a wrong field name will not be caught when the code is built. Most of the component was not reviewed.
debug: If the wrong pop-up opens, check the kind value passed in. If details are missing from a pop-up, check the payload fields the caller sends against what the dialog reads.
